operation_details.item: The campaign was originally planned to launch in June.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the campaign coming along this week?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It’s in good shape overall. We originally planned to launch in June, but that timeline has shifted.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It’s now planned to launch in July. The extra time allowed us to finish the new creative properly.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a worthwhile tradeoff. Is the new launch date settled?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the July launch date is locked in the campaign calendar.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only the original June launch plan and retain the current July plan and its rationale.
